reflections.summary: The protected Tailwind lead gave Mega Ampharos safe speed control, while focused attacks removed Castform, Gyarados, and Mega Medicham before they could contribute; Prankster Taunt then disabled Aegislash. The chosen four and Mega Ampharos were well suited, though the two back Pokémon were not needed.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and Mega Evolve Ampharos; against Aegislash, maintain Taunt and use neutral Thunder rather than resisted Dragon Pulse or Power Gem, switching to an accurate finisher only when it guarantees the knockout.
reflections.notebook: Opponent may pivot the Medicham–Gyarados lead into Castform–Aegislash. Mega Medicham is the chosen Mega. Aegislash has Attract and is highly vulnerable to Prankster Taunt, which can force Struggle; Ampharos should attack it with Thunder because Dragon Pulse and Power Gem are resisted. Castform has Sunny Day and is vulnerable to Taunt or Encore. Gyarados has Intimidate and Lash Out. Stunfisk-Galar favors Crunch; Encore can exploit it, while Mudsdale can absorb it, gain Stamina, and threaten with High Horsepower. Retain Whimsicott, Mega Ampharos, Mudsdale, and Choice Scarf Basculegion, using protected Tailwind and focused pressure on Mega Medicham.

reflections.summary: Lost because the previewed four (Medicham-Mega/Gyarados/Castform/Aegislash) had no answer to Whimsicott’s Prankster Tailwind/Taunt/Encore + Focus Sash and Ampharos-Mega’s Mold Breaker Thunder/Dragon Pulse; Castform and Medicham died to consecutive super-effective special hits, Gyarados was removed by Thunder, and Aegislash was taunt-locked into Struggle. Medichamite was the wrong Mega choice here—Medicham-Mega is weak to both Fairy and Dragon and was forced in unsafely with no pivot.
reflections.adjustment: Drop Castform and Aegislash from the four; keep Gyarados but do not Mega evolve Medicham—leave the Mega slot empty or on a different holder—because Medicham-Mega cannot survive double Moonblast/Dragon Pulse entry. Lead Gyarados with an immediate Whimsicott/Sash-breaking partner, deny Tailwind on turn 1, and only bring Medicham in late after Whimsicott is KO’d and Tailwind has expired.
reflections.notebook: Opponent core: Whimsicott (Focus Sash, Prankster, Tailwind, Taunt, Encore, Moonblast; immune to Attract). Ampharos-Mega (Mold Breaker, Modest, Thunder/Dragon Pulse/Power Gem/Protect; Mega evolves T1; uses Protect). Backline revealed: Basculegion (Choice Scarf, Adaptability, Adamant, Flip Turn/Psychic Fangs); Politoed (Drizzle, Sitrus Berry, Calm, Icy Wind/Haze/Protect); Tsareena (Wide Lens, Queenly Majesty, Adamant, High Jump Kick/Knock Off/Protect); Mudsdale (Leftovers, Stamina, Adamant, High Horsepower/Rock Slide/Body Press). Key facts: Castform/Sunny Day is useless here; Aegislash is taunt-bait; Medicham-Mega dies to this Fairy/Dragon coverage; Intimidate does not stop Thunder; Tailwind lasts ~4 turns but must be stopped early; rain option exists. Future plan: never bring Castform/Aegislash vs this opponent; avoid Medichamite unless Whimsicott is gone and Tailwind down; lead Intimidate + Sash-breaker; save Medicham for endgame only; watch Politoed rain and Basculegion Flip Turn/Scarf pressure.
